_about: Site-wide facts for tools/site.py. The tool stamps every page's <!-- chrome:meta --> block from
this file plus the page's own <title>, description and path, and writes sitemap.xml and llms.txt.
Each page owns its title and description; put here only what a page can't say about itself.
An ar/ page takes its English twin's entry (type, group, audience, index), not its words.
A text may be one string or {"en": ..., "ar": ...}.
Empty strings and empty lists are skipped (never shipped as placeholders): fill them when the
owner supplies the fact. Keep every sentence here true to design/brief/app-facts.md.
name: Klaro

image._about: The share image (og:image) of every page: 1200x630 (1.91:1), a JPG because every link preview reads JPG. A centre crop of illustration 01. A page-specific image can come later.

alt.en: An open course book, a film strip and an exam paper, joined by one gold thread.
alt.ar: كتاب كورس مفتوح وشريط فيلم وورقة امتحان، يربطها خيط ذهبي واحد.

fonts._about: Google Fonts families per language, written by tools/site.py into every page's meta block. Readex Pro (the Arabic face) only on Arabic pages.

srcset._about: When on, tools/site.py gives every of a full-size illustration (img/ill/NN-name.webp, 1200px) a srcset of its -480 and -800 versions and these sizes; a lazy image's sizes start with 'auto', so Chrome uses its drawn size (never on an eager image: Chrome then takes the full width). Off until the page branches are merged, so it doesn't collide with their edits: then set on to true and run the tool.

org.description: Klaro is a study platform for tutors and their students. Tutors upload their own recorded lectures, course book and past papers, and Klaro links them, so students study the lecture, the book and past-paper questions side by side.
org._slogan: Draft from design/brief/redesign.md 8.1, option 1 (owner to approve). The literal motto left the site.
org.slogan: We don't make content. We connect yours.

facts: For tutors and their students. Students join a tutor's course with a join code. Every tutor account is reviewed before it opens.
The lectures are the tutor's own, the book is the tutor's book, and the questions come from real past papers. Nothing generated.
Each lecture clip is linked to the part of the book it teaches and to past-paper questions on the same topic. The Klaro team checks and publishes each course.
Built for IGCSE, A Level and SAT, in English and Arabic. In Arabic the whole layout turns right to left.
Works in the browser on phone, tablet and computer.
Motto: "We don't make content. We connect yours."
